text:
Aria: FYI NovaFin pushed back on our SLA draft. They want p99 <= 450ms at 500 qps for their realtime route. Can we hit that with current kernels and config?
Ravi: short answer: not without tradeoffs. p95 is fine, p99 will spike under sustained 500 qps because of KV misses + kernel fallback thrash + large microbatches.
Noah: sales note — kickoff doc had an informal promise of <500ms p99 for Dedicated. Customer's CTO is asking for a path to compliance, not immediate cancellation.
Megan: perf-bot flagged a regression after last night's kernel-path tweak.
perf-bot: nightly-run 1715000000 baseline->HEAD
perf-bot: p95 180ms -> 190ms (+5.6%)
perf-bot: p99 420ms -> 520ms (+23.8%) ALERT
Lena: digging logs: KV miss rate climbs during sustained load. Looks like our TTL bump + scheduler churn evicted hot prefixes.
Ravi: added context: new kernel selector prefers fp8-quant for short sequences then falls back to fp16 for longer tails. That fallback incurs context-switch overhead and misaligned microbatch boundaries.
Ravi: also we bumped max_microbatch to 64 recently for throughput; at 500 qps with broad tail distribution we get head-of-line blocking.
Aria: so likely root causes: 1) KV warmup/miss amplification 2) kernel affinity/fallback thrash 3) large microbatches making HOB worse. We need prioritized mitigations.
Ravi: short-term plan (route-level): cap microbatch to 16 for novafin route, enforce kernel_affinity (pin to optimized_fp16 path), enable aggressive KV prefill for known prefixes.
Megan: ran a local sim. Results look promising: lowering microbatch reduces p99 significantly, p95 slightly up.
Megan: sim snippet:
```
route=novafin qps=500
microbatch=64 -> p95 190ms p99 520ms
microbatch=16 -> p95 200ms p99 360ms
microbatch=16 + kv_prefill -> p99 320ms
```
Noah: if we drop microbatch to 16 what's the throughput hit? customer needs consistency.
Ravi: estimated throughput loss ~8-12% in our sim. Dedicated reserved pool should handle the delta if we adjust autoscale/burst and maybe add one extra GPU slot.
Lena: SRE note — more kernel launches with smaller microbatches could raise GPU occupancy and temp. I'll add a heatmap and alert thresholds.
Aria: could we ship these knobs as an interim SLA carveout for NovaFin (route-specific config + throughput caveat)?
Ravi: yes. Router supports per-route overrides. Implementation items:
- set route=novafin microbatch_max=16
- set kernel_affinity=optimized_fp16
- enable kv_prefill for top-10 prefixes
- canary at 10% traffic for 2h
- collect perf-bot metrics/heatmap and SRE alerts
Megan: I'll prepare a one-pager for sales with tradeoffs and numbers; include sim logs and expected canary dashboards. ETA 24h.
Lena: I'll write SRE runbook: canary monitor, rollback steps, GPU alerts (p99 increase >15% or GPU temp >80C -> pager).
Noah: i'll tell NovaFin we can try a carveout: target p99 350ms for critical route with these runtime configs and a ~10% throughput caveat. Will that be defensible?
Aria: good negotiation start. Add a rollback clause and a short-term monitoring SLA so they see evidence.
Ravi: rolling plan:
- create routing policy and env flags
- deploy canary config to 10% at 1715000230
- perf-bot to collect 15/60/120m snapshots
- SRE heatmap + alerting
- if canary p99 <= 360ms and stable -> expand to 100% gradually
Megan: perf-bot: canary-start 1715000230 route=novafin traffic=10%
Megan: collecting metrics, will post a short summary in #eng-runtime-canaries in ~90m.
Lena: adding alert rule: route=novafin p99 > 400ms -> pager to oncall.
Noah: customer verbally okayed trying canary. Sales wants the one-pager before we hit 100%.
Aria: run brief updates here only. Ravi/Megan/Lena sync in 30 to gate canary. Noah, keep customer updated.
Ravi: starting config push in 5. Ping immediately on anomalies.
perf-bot: canary-metrics-1 1715000900 route=novafin traffic=10% p95=205ms p99=355ms kv_miss=2.8% gpu_temp_avg=72C
Megan: initial canary looks within expected range. p99 improved from 520->355ms. p95 increased slightly. Sharing dashboard link in #eng-runtime-canaries.
Lena: GPU heatmap looks OK, utilization up ~6%, temps acceptable. No alerts fired.
Noah: i'll update NovaFin with preliminary numbers and the planned expansion schedule. :thumbsup: 
Aria: if canary holds for 2h with stable p99 we'll draft SLA addendum. Thanks team.
perf-bot: canary-end 1715001430 route=novafin traffic=100% decision=pending
Aria: keep thread concise with final decision; append canary artifacts to the one-pager.
